correctness.rationale: A case-complete proof splits intersecting two-set families into stars/triangles and nonintersecting families into unique four-label supports; all subfamilies of those supports are feasible. This gives the exact polynomial, and maximality follows from single-vertex extensions. The listed exact internal determinants prove strict log-concavity for n<=12 and failures beyond; the coefficient differences and binomial tail prove unimodality except n=14. Direct checker tested 2,131,008 subsets n=4..7 and all maximality extensions and shape n=4..500, but the infinite result relies on symbolic identities.

value.rationale: Kneser graphs are a canonical family in extremal combinatorics. Full enumeration of dissociation configurations and maximal sets goes beyond their previously known maximum size. The isolated order-14 unimodality failure with permanent recovery for n>=15 and persistent log-concavity failure from 13 is a motivated, sharp global shape phenomenon that cannot be read from the earlier scalar invariant. The star/four-label count also explains exactly the observed distribution and purity transition.
